description: Two-axis separation of helix classes: Wimley-White hydrophobic-face transfer free energy per face residue versus small-residue fraction of the hydrophobic face, recomputed from sequence for all 24 helices
code:
import math, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
WWI=dict(A=.17,R=.81,N=.42,D=1.23,C=-.24,Q=.58,E=2.02,G=.01,H=.96,I=-.31,L=-.56,K=.99,M=-.23,
         F=-1.13,P=.45,S=.13,T=.14,W=-1.85,Y=-.94,V=.07)
APOLAR=set("AVLIMFWCY"); SMALL=set("GASTCP"); BULKY=set("LIMFWVY")

SEQS=[
 ("AP3D1 human 1-24","AP-3 delta (query)","MALKMVKGSIDRMFDKNLQDLVRG"),
 ("AP3D1 human 1-14","AP-3 delta (query)","MALKMVKGSIDRMF"),
 ("AP3D C.elegans 1-24","AP-3 delta (query)","MALRKVRSNIDRIFDKSLTDLIRG"),
 ("AP3D Drosophila 1-24","AP-3 delta (query)","MALKKVKGNFFERMFDKNLTDLVR"),
 ("Apl5 yeast 1-24","AP-3 delta (query)","MTSLYAPGAEDIRQRLRPFGFFFE"),
 ("AP1G1 1-24","adaptin paralog","MPAPIRLRELIRTIRTARTQAEER"),
 ("AP2A1 1-24","adaptin paralog","MPAVSKGDGMRGLAVFISDIRNCK"),
 ("AP2B1 1-24","adaptin paralog","MTDSKYFTTNKKGEIFELKAELNN"),
 ("AP3B1 1-24","adaptin paralog","MSSNSFPYNEQSGGGEATELGQEA"),
 ("AP4E1 1-24","adaptin paralog","MSDIVEKTLTALPGLFLQNQPGGG"),
 ("epsin1 H0","membrane-inserting","MSTSSLRRQMKNIVHNYS"),
 ("amphiphysin1 H0","membrane-inserting","MADIKTGIFAKNVQKRLNRAQEKVLQK"),
 ("BIN1 H0","membrane-inserting","MAEMGSKGVTAGKIASNVQKKLTRAQE"),
 ("alpha-synuclein 1-25","membrane-inserting","MDVFMKGLSKAKEGVVAAAEKTKQG"),
 ("Sar1A 1-23","membrane-inserting","MSFIFEWIYNGFSSVLQFLGLYK"),
 ("Arf1 1-17","membrane-inserting","MGNIFANLFKGLFGKKE"),
 ("ArfGAP1 ALPS1","ALPS sensor","MSSLYSGWSSFTTGASRFASAAK"),
 ("ArfGAP1 ALPS2","ALPS sensor","FGSQASQKASELGHSLNENVLKPAQ"),
 ("Nup133 ALPS","ALPS sensor","SGIGRKVSSLFGILSPSSDLTL"),
 ("GMAP210 ALPS","ALPS sensor","MSSWLGGLGSGLGQSLGQVGGSLASLTGQISNFTKDML"),
 ("ATG14 ALPS","ALPS sensor","PIASSSAGGMISSAAASVTSWFKAYTGHR"),
 ("ApoA-I class A","surface-binding control","ATEHLSTLSEKAKPALEDLRQG"),
]

rows=[]
for name,cls,s in SEQS:
    n=len(s); th=np.deg2rad(np.arange(n)*100.)
    h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in s])
    mx=(h*np.cos(th)).sum(); my=(h*np.sin(th)).sum()
    muH=math.hypot(mx,my)/n; phi=math.atan2(my,mx)
    d=np.angle(np.exp(1j*(th-phi)))
    face=[s[i] for i in range(n) if abs(d[i])<=np.pi/2]
    dG=sum(WWI[a] for a in face)
    rows.append(dict(name=name, cls=cls, n=n, muH=muH, face="".join(face),
                     dG_face=dG, dG_per_face_res=dG/len(face),
                     small_frac=sum(a in SMALL for a in face)/len(face),
                     bulky_frac=sum(a in BULKY for a in face)/len(face)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(df[["name","cls","muH","dG_per_face_res","small_frac","bulky_frac","face"]].to_string(index=False))

COL={"AP-3 delta (query)":"#d62728","adaptin paralog":"#7f7f7f","membrane-inserting":"#1f77b4",
     "ALPS sensor":"#2ca02c","surface-binding control":"#ff7f0e"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,7))
for cls,g in df.groupby("cls"):
    ax.scatter(g.dG_per_face_res,g.small_frac,s=130,c=COL[cls],label=cls,
               edgecolor="k",linewidth=.6,zorder=3)
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r["name"].replace(" 1-24","").replace(" 1-14"," (1-14)"),
                (r.dG_per_face_res,r.small_frac),fontsize=7.5,
                xytext=(5,4),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8,ls=":")
ax.axvspan(-0.70,-0.25,color="#1f77b4",alpha=.06,zorder=0)
ax.set_xlabel("Wimley-White interfacial transfer free energy of the hydrophobic face\n(kcal/mol per face residue; more negative = stronger partitioning)")
ax.set_ylabel("small-residue fraction of the hydrophobic face (G,A,S,T,C,P)")
ax.set_title("AP3D1 1-14 is amphipathic but partitions weakly, and its face is\nbulky rather than ALPS-like")
ax.legend(loc="upper left",fontsize=8,frameon=True)
ax.grid(alpha=.25)
plt.show()
